label: Me
notes: CH3 is also a plain formula label; resolve CH3 as Me.

label: Et
notes: RDKit/Marvin agree.

label: nPr
notes: Pr (unprefixed) means n-propyl by convention, but Pr is also praseodymium (element-first lookup wins).

label: nBu
notes: Bu without prefix means n-butyl.

label: iBu
notes: RDKit's built-in iBu is *C(C)CC, which is sec-butyl (an RDKit bug); Ketcher/Marvin/IUPAC = isobutyl.

label: sBu
notes: Stereocentre at C1 left unspecified.

label: tBu
notes: 'But' (Bu^t) is the older British spelling.

label: nPent
notes: 'Am' (amyl) is deliberately NOT a synonym: Am = americium.

label: iAm
notes: RDKit's iPent is *C(C)CCC (= 2-pentyl, a bug); iPent therefore not listed as synonym.

label: neoPent
notes: Np is sometimes used for neopentyl but collides with neptunium and Marvin's Np (p-nitrophenyl); not a synonym.

label: nHept
notes: RDKit uses 'Hept' for the divalent -(CH2)7- linker; here Hept = heptyl. Resolve by bond count if needed.

label: Ad
notes: 1-adamantyl (bridgehead). 2-adamantyl must be drawn explicitly.

label: Cinnamyl
notes: (E)-cinnamyl.

label: Tol
notes: Unqualified Tol = p-tolyl.

label: Mes
notes: Ketcher's 'Mes' template is actually 3-methylbenzyl (bug). Very old literature used Mes for mesyl; use Ms.

label: Dipp
notes: Marvin names it Dip.

label: Tipp
notes: 'Trip' also names the TRIP chiral phosphoric acid; Tipp is unambiguous.

label: C6F5
notes: Pfp is used mostly in active esters (OPfp).

label: 1-Naph
notes: Marvin's 'Naph' = 1-naphthyl.

label: 2-Py
notes: Marvin's 'Py' = 2-pyridyl; 'py' (lower case) usually means the pyridine ligand.

label: 2-Thienyl
notes: 'Th' alone is thorium; not a synonym.

label: 3-Indolyl
notes: Ketcher labels this template 'Indole'. 'Ind' is avoided (also indenyl).

label: Im
notes: N-bound, as in CDI / Im-C(O)-.

label: Biph
notes: 'Bip' also = biphenylalanine in peptide work.

label: Ac
notes: Ac is also actinium. The editor must prefer acetyl in a label context (see collisions.md).

label: Bz
notes: Bz = benzoyl (IUPAC/Greene). Some authors misuse Bz for benzyl; benzyl is Bn (or Bzl in peptide chemistry).

label: Tfa
notes: Marvin calls this 'TFA', but TFA normally means trifluoroacetic acid (a solvent/reagent), so TFA is not a synonym.

label: Lev
notes: Protecting group (esters).

label: Dde
notes: 1-(4,4-dimethyl-2,6-dioxocyclohexylidene)ethyl.

label: Phth
notes: Divalent: both acyl carbons attach (normally to the same N). For the imide substituent use NPhth.

label: Ts
notes: Ts is also tennessine (element 117).

label: Ns
notes: Ns usually = 2-nitrobenzenesulfonyl (Fukuyama); some authors use Ns for the 4-isomer (pNs).

label: Trisyl
notes: 'Tris' is also used but collides with the TRIS buffer; not a synonym.

label: Pbf
notes: 2,2,4,6,7-pentamethyl-2,3-dihydrobenzofuran-5-sulfonyl (Arg side chain).

label: Pmc
notes: 2,2,5,7,8-pentamethylchroman-6-sulfonyl.

label: Bn
notes: Bzl is the peptide-chemistry spelling. Never Bz (= benzoyl).

label: DMB
notes: DMB usually = 2,4-dimethoxybenzyl; the 3,4-isomer is DMPM.

label: Nap
notes: 2-naphthylmethyl.

label: EE
notes: 1-ethoxyethyl; stereocentre unspecified.

label: THP
notes: Tetrahydropyran-2-yl; stereocentre unspecified.

label: Acm
notes: Acetamidomethyl (Cys).

label: TBDPS
notes: Ketcher's TBDPS template is malformed (5-valent Si, isopropyl instead of tBu).

label: SiPh3
notes: TPS is ambiguous (triphenylsilyl vs. 2,4,6-triisopropylbenzenesulfonyl); label kept as SiPh3.

label: DTBS
notes: Di-tert-butylsilylene (diol protection), divalent. Marvin's DTBS wrongly inserts CH2 groups.

label: TIPDS
notes: 1,1,3,3-tetraisopropyldisiloxane-1,3-diyl, divalent.

label: OBn
notes: Open Babel's list maps OBz to benzyloxy (wrong); OBz = benzoyloxy.

label: OMs
notes: Open Babel's OMs SMILES is wrong (CS(O)(=O)=O).

label: OSu
notes: N-succinimidyloxy (NHS ester).

label: OPO3H2
notes: Ketcher/Marvin call this PO4H2.

label: SCN
notes: Left form NCS is textually identical to the isothiocyanate label.

label: SO2Me
notes: Same structure as Ms.

label: NHMe
notes: RDKit's 'NMe' abbreviation is this (monovalent NHMe); here NMe is the divalent N-methyl.

label: N(OH)CH3
notes: From RDKit.

label: NHCF3
notes: RDKit labels this NCF3.

label: NO2
notes: Charge-separated form; Open Babel also lists pentavalent N(=O)=O.

label: NC
notes: Left form of CN is 'NC' and vice versa - text alone cannot tell them apart; keep the group identity, not the text.

label: NMe
notes: Divalent N-methyl (ring nitrogen). RDKit's NMe is monovalent NHMe - conflict.

label: NBn
notes: Divalent.

label: NBoc
notes: Divalent.

label: NCbz
notes: Divalent.

label: NTs
notes: Divalent.

label: NPh
notes: Divalent.

label: NAc
notes: Divalent.

label: CO2tBu
notes: Same structure as Boc (different intent/label).

label: CO2Bn
notes: Same structure as Cbz.

label: PPh2
notes: sigma-bonded diphenylphosphanyl.

label: Cp
notes: Stored as sigma-C5H5 (Ketcher does the same). eta5 hapticity is not captured.

label: Cp*
notes: Stored as sigma-C5Me5; eta5 hapticity not captured.

label: PPh3
notes: L-type ligand: attachment is a dative P->M bond. Needs dative-bond support in the editor.

label: PCy3
notes: Dative, as PPh3.

label: PtBu3
notes: Dative, as PPh3.

label: PMe3
notes: Dative, as PPh3.

label: CE
notes: 2-cyanoethyl (phosphoramidite chemistry). Marvin spells it 'Ce', which is cerium - not a synonym.

label: Dnp
notes: 2,4-dinitrophenyl (also a His/Cys protecting group).

label: PPh3+
notes: Triphenylphosphonio (Wittig salts); counter-ion drawn separately.

label: OSO3H
notes: Ketcher calls this SO4H.

label: NTf2
notes: Bis(triflyl)amido, e.g. AgNTf2 / Au-NTf2 drawn with an M-N bond.

label: Ade
notes: Adenin-9-yl. Marvin adds a 2nd attachment on N6.

label: Gua
notes: Guanin-9-yl.

label: Cyt
notes: Cytosin-1-yl.

label: Thy
notes: Thymin-1-yl.

label: Ura
notes: Uracil-1-yl.

label: CO
notes: Divalent carbonyl. 'CO' also means carbon monoxide as a ligand; treat as carbonyl when two bonds attach.

label: SO2
notes: Divalent sulfonyl (ChemDraw hotkey k). Ketcher's SO2 template is a monovalent HSO2 (hypervalent S-H), not used.

label: PEG3
notes: RDKit definition -(OCH2CH2)3-. Other tools count PEG units differently (e.g. ending in O).

label: PEG4
notes: RDKit definition.

label: PEG5
notes: RDKit definition.

label: PEG6
notes: RDKit definition.
